name: Time Reaper
oracle_text:
Flying, haste
Consume Anomaly — Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, put target face-up card they own in exile on the bottom of their library. If you do, you gain 3 life.
blocked_sentences: Consume Anomaly — Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, put target face-up card they own in exile on the bottom of their library. If you do, you gain 3 life.

needs.what: a selector key that matches a card in exile by whether it is face up or face down (i.e. reads GameObject.hidden_in_exile), usable in a card_in_exile target's selector: "target face-up card they own in exile"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The selector key `face_down` reads only the 708.2 permanent state and the loader refuses it beside any zone other than the battlefield; face-down exile (Necropotence, hideaway, foretell-style, search_zones/exile with face_down) is tracked separately as `hidden_in_exile`, which no selector key reads. Without it a card_in_exile target over {controller: {binding: event_player}} could pick a face-down exiled card, which the printed text forbids. The rest of the line is expressible: trigger deals_combat_damage_to_player, target kind card_in_exile, put_on_top with bottom: true and `as`, then `if` on the bound count > 0 for gain_life 3.
